regions.region: page 19 upper-left continuation of rac-11c characterization
regions.finding: Continuation of the existing rac-11c analytical block (13C/19F NMR, IR, HRMS); no new reaction run was created.

regions.region: page 19 left column rac-11d and rac-11f experimental paragraphs
regions.finding: Merged explicit GP4 ester/EtOH/2 M NaOH charges, 45 min or 2.5 h duration, isolated masses, yields, and the approximately 1:1 rac-11f diastereomeric mixture into the two existing hydrolysis records.

regions.region: page 19 lower-left (S)-12 preparation
regions.finding: Added one GP1 N-alkylation record with all measured charges, xylene carrier, reflux/72 h context from GP1, column purification, >99% yield, and the source's (S)-12 versus (S)-9 label conflict.

regions.region: page 19 right column rac-14a through rac-14c and start of rac-14d
regions.finding: Merged measured charges, durations, purification, isolated masses, and yields into the existing CuI-catalyzed coupling records; rac-14d continues on page 20.

unresolved: The (S)-12 heading conflicts with the result sentence's (S)-9 label.
Some GP4 workup details are inherited from the already-covered page-17 general procedure; page 19 supplies the row-specific measured charges and times.

regions.region: page 20 upper-left continuation of rac-14d plus rac-14e/rac-14f
regions.finding: Completed rac-14d and merged the rac-14e/rac-14f experimental charges, times, column eluents, mixture designation, isolated masses, and yields into existing records. Crude diazo masses remain masses without inferred mmol.

regions.region: page 20 lower-left to upper-right rac-14g
regions.finding: Merged the distinct CuI/LiOtBu/tosylhydrazone-18 coupling, 90 °C/1 h hold, room-temperature cooling, filtration, column purification, 107 mg/60%, and approximately 1:1 mixture into its existing Scheme 3 record.

regions.region: page 20 right column rac-16a and rac-16b
regions.finding: Merged measured GP3 charges, 30 °C holds (1 h for rac-16a and 30 min for rac-16b), purification, isolated masses, and yields; rac-16b characterization continues on page 21.

unresolved: The experimental paragraphs describe some diaryldiazomethanes only as crude masses; purity, mmol, and reliable equivalents are not printed and were not inferred.

regions.region: page 21 upper-left rac-16b continuation and rac-16c through rac-16f
regions.finding: Classified the rac-16b block as characterization continuation and merged explicit preparations of rac-16c-f into their existing independent coupling records, including crude-diazo caveats and the rac-16f approximately 1:1 mixture.

regions.region: page 21 lower-left hydrazone 18 preparation
regions.finding: Added one ordered preparation record: dissolve at 60 °C, cool to room temperature, slowly add tetralone, crystallize after 1 h and overnight, filter/wash/dry. The printed isolated marker '3.30' lacks a visible unit and remains nonnumeric; yield is 96%.

regions.region: page 21 upper-right GAT binding and uptake assay methods
regions.finding: Method text supports the existing current-paper Table 1 binding/uptake records (mGAT1 membrane MS binding with NO711 and intact-HEK293 [3H]GABA uptake for mGAT1-mGAT4); it contains no new compound-specific outcome row.

regions.region: page 21 right-column animal housing and ethics
regions.finding: General adult male CD-1 mouse housing, group-size range, study-time window, euthanasia, and ethics information supports the behavioral records; it is not a standalone pharmacological outcome.

unresolved: The hydrazone isolated marker '3.30' has no visible unit on the original page.
The assay-method paragraphs omit several well-level charges and are not expanded into duplicate assay records.

regions.region: page 22 upper-left chemicals and common administration
regions.finding: Merged the 1% Tween-80 vehicle, intraperitoneal DDPM-3960 route, 60 min pretreatment interval, and challenge-chemical vehicles into the existing in vivo records; no new efficacy outcomes were invented.

regions.region: page 22 PTZ, MES, electroconvulsive-threshold, 6-Hz, and pilocarpine methods
regions.finding: Added challenge doses/routes, electrical stimulus parameters, observation windows, endpoint definitions, tetracaine/saline eye treatments, and scopolamine pretreatment to the five existing anticonvulsant records.

regions.region: page 22 rotarod, grip-strength, locomotor, four-plate, elevated-plus-maze, and forced-swim methods
regions.finding: Added ordered training/pretreatment/test stages, apparatus settings, stimulus parameters, observation times, and water-temperature range to the existing records. The hot-plate method begins here and continues on page 23.

unresolved: Raw per-animal observations and complete group allocations are not printed on this page.
The hot-plate temperature/cutoff continue on page 23.

regions.region: page 23 upper-left hot-plate, capsaicin, and formalin methods
regions.finding: Merged the 55-56 °C hot-plate range/60 s cutoff, capsaicin 1.6 µg in 20 µL saline/ethanol 5:1, and 20 µL 5% formalin with phase-specific scoring windows into their existing outcome records.

regions.region: page 23 pharmacokinetic study and LC-MS/MS method
regions.finding: Merged 30 mg/kg i.p. dosing, exact 15-720 min sampling schedule, serum preparation/storage, 1:4 brain homogenization, 50/150 µL extraction, shake/centrifuge/injection settings, and noncompartmental analysis into the existing PK record.

regions.region: page 23 stability-study method
regions.finding: Merged 10 µM DDPM-3960/procaine, DMSO <=1%, 50 µL samples, 37 °C duplicate time course, 150 µL quench, and LC-MS/MS processing into the existing stability record.

regions.region: page 23 lower-right start of in vivo serum-protein binding
regions.finding: Merged n=2 treated and two blank-serum mice, 30 mg/kg i.p., 30 min collection, anesthesia/exsanguination, and serum centrifugation into the existing in vivo binding record; ultrafiltration continues on page 24.

unresolved: The valsartan internal-standard concentration and complete time-point animal allocation are not printed.
The exact serum/brain donor pooling details for stability are not reported.

regions.region: page 24 upper-left completion of in vivo and in vitro serum-protein binding
regions.finding: Merged 50 µL stored/approximately 200 µL filtered in vivo aliquots, 15 min at 1000g, 30 kDa membrane, and the separate 250 µL/1 µg mL-1 in vitro serum/PBS experiment with 200 µL duplicate 37 °C/30 min incubation, -80 °C storage, LC-MS/MS, and published fu/NSB equations.

regions.region: page 24 middle-left binding-mode prediction
regions.finding: Merged ligand/protein preparation at pH 7.4, explicit protonation states, PDB cleanup, AutoDock/DrugScore2018 whole-target docking, 3 Å clustering, and >=20% cluster validity criterion into the existing docking record.

regions.region: page 24 Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: The publisher lists CSV and PDF Supporting Information, but workspace association fields remain unestablished; no SI content was imported or inferred.

regions.region: page 24 right column author information, notes, acknowledgments, and abbreviations
regions.finding: Administrative and glossary material only; no additional reaction, assay row, outcome, or mechanism appears.

unresolved: Approximately 50% nonspecific ultrafiltration-device binding may overestimate serum-protein binding.
Docking random seeds, full pose counts/scores, and all search parameters are not printed.
The SI notice does not establish a workspace SI association.
